chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Yaqub ibn Yazeed, from Muhammad ibn Aslam, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed Allah, the Majestic and Mighty, has assigned an Angel to regulate the price, so it will not become high due to scarcity, nor become low due to abundance.

key_terms.يَرْخُصَ: To become low / Drop in price

ai.seo_question: How does divine intervention regulate market prices according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the concept of divine providence (tawqīf) in economic affairs, where an angel ensures market equilibrium by preventing excessive inflation during scarcity and unjust price drops during abundance. It underscores the Shia view that while human agents manage trade, ultimate price stability is under God's direct supervision, reinforcing trust in divine justice within commercial transactions. This mechanism serves as a theological counterbalance to human greed and market volatility, affirming that economic fluctuations are not merely random but subject to celestial oversight.
